summary: Nginx is running persistently on all four nodes and serves HTTP / on TCP 6700. Every node was restarted individually; each boot ID changed and Nginx, listeners, configuration, and content recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx on AlmaLinux node1/node2 and Alpine node3/node4.
Configured persistent IPv4 and IPv6 listeners on TCP 6700 with node-specific index content.
Added persistent SELinux http_port_t and firewalld allowances on AlmaLinux.
Enabled Nginx through systemd on AlmaLinux and OpenRC on Alpine.
Restarted nodes sequentially and verified boot identity changes and post-restart recovery.
Captured final HTTP 200 health checks through each node's managed IP.
